notes.title: Release of Star Mine Second Edition
notes.notes:
Release of Star Mine Second Edition.

Check out the new improvements to Star Mine. You can now try before you buy via a demo build that allows you to play the first two levels!

Star Mine now includes a voice computer assistant the reports status, warns of threats or opportunities. It helps guide game play and provides hints based on what the radar display picks up or if shield energy levels get too low.

The level selector has been improved to make it easier to load unlocked levels. The title graphics and music have been revised and new a hyperspace animation has been provided.

We hope you have fun blasting aliens!
